name: prof-opt-noopt
description: Is dotc faster when the compiler and library are built with Scala 2's optimizer (`-opt -opt-inline`), on today's C2? Same commit (`0c8314024c`) built twice; the build toggle is [retronym/scala3#12](https://github.com/retronym/scala3/pull/12). Plan: `bench-lab/doc/opt-noopt.md`.
- Smoke run (loaded machine): noopt +18% instructions/op but fewer ms/op, IPC 2.39 vs 2.28.

variantDescriptions.opt: The default build: `scala3-compiler-bootstrapped` with `-opt -opt-inline:dotty.**`, the library with `-opt -opt-inline:**,!java.**`.
variantDescriptions.noopt: `Global / Build.optimize := false` (`noopt.sbt`; same setting as `SCALA3_BUILD_OPTIMIZE=false`): no optimizer flags for the compiler or the library.
